units.source_text: 那个男人病危了，而她却到岛村那里过夜。

en.t: That man was critically ill, yet she went to spend the night at Shimamura's place.

units.source_text: 她还仿佛要委身于他似地说：“我爱怎样就怎样，一个快死的人怎能禁得住我呢？”

en.t: She even spoke as though she were giving herself to him: "I will do as I please. How could a dying man possibly stop me?"
